svg.desc: Constructed diagram of the AI Usage window with example figures: a 38 percent gauge over a line of tokens used, a reset date and when the figure was checked, call counts, daily bars by feature, and the note on what every plan includes. The numbers are invented for the guide.
svg.text: Example figures, drawn for this guide. Not a reading from a real membership.
